T4.9.message: The story details are almost all backed by taittiriya-upanishad-3-1.md (Taitt. Up. 3.1.1): Bhṛgu goes to his father Varuṇa, asks to be taught Brahman, gets the 'from which born / by which live / into which merge' clue, then does tapas. Two small embellishments have no excerpt behind them. (1) 'Young Bhṛgu' / 'युवा भृगु': the source only says he is Varuṇa's son (वारुणिः), not that he is young. (2) 'Bhṛgu goes away to reflect' / 'तप करने चला जाता है': the source says 'स तपोऽतप्यत' ('He practised concentration'). It says nothing about him leaving. Both are minor, so a human should decide whether to keep them.
T4.9.suggested_fix: Drop 'Young'/'युवा'. Change the last sentence to 'Bhṛgu sets himself to deep concentration (tapas).' / 'भृगु ने तप किया।'
